finding.summary: V6 bundle-risk research currently multiplies marginal per-leg fill probabilities to model joint completion and derives incomplete-state probabilities from the same independence assumption. Marginal probabilities alone do not identify same-window multi-leg completion or partial-fill state frequencies.

latest_completed_aggressive_forward_evid.source: PR #302 completed forward smoke before this audit

identification_counterexample.note: Both processes have identical 2% marginal leg-fill probabilities. Joint completion can therefore differ from zero to 2%; multiplying marginals is an unvalidated dependence assumption, not execution evidence.

successor_experiment.primary_metric: fill-conditioned bundle PnL after completion and incomplete-state unwind
requirements: Partition public post-entry tape into common chronological windows equal to the candidate fill horizon.
Within each window and leg, require compatible sell flow to clear queue_ahead plus actual target shares.
Record the full fill-state bitmask for all legs in the same window.
Estimate full-completion and every partial-fill state frequency directly from common windows; do not multiply marginal fill probabilities.
Use block/bootstrap uncertainty over chronological windows and fail closed when independent-window support is insufficient.
Price every partial state using candidate-specific displayed unwind depth, verified fees, slippage and latency/adverse-selection stress at 1x, 1.5x and 2x.
Compare empirical state-based EV against the current independence proxy on identical candidates and chronology.
